name: Justin Timberlake
notes: The bridge between this lane and `rnb-2000s`, and the one entry here whose signature singles the research calls **half-time-feeling** outright — "backbeat effectively on 3 with a 2/2 pulse" at 74–80 — so `halfTime` is true and the snare moves to `halftime_3`. The session window is trimmed to the half-time band; the straight-time end of the stated 74–120 spread is the other backbeat class and a single session block cannot carry both, so it is named here instead of encoded. Drums are quoted directly: "kick sparse and syncopated" (density 1–3, `syncopation` 0.55), "16th and 32nd hat stutters as the fill vocabulary" (a 16/32 roll vocabulary firing twice a bar), and "beatboxed and sampled percussion layered with programmed kit" plus "vocal percussion doubles the hat", which is the three-lane perc block. The low end is a synth sub with "long tied notes, dropping out on the turnaround" — a synth bass, not an 808, so no `bass808` block is authored and the inherited null is what lets the bassline generator run at all; `mirror_kick` is the tied-note reading. Harmony is i–VI–VII loops with "no functional cadence", which is why the families never contain a V. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are the drum probabilities, `bpm.mode` 78 (the centre of the stated 74–80 signature band) and the modal colour weighting — the research says "modal/'Arabic' scale colour on the riff" and `harmonic_minor` is the nearest legal scale name to that description. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than the held `reese_sustain` the research describes** — *“synth sub, long tied notes, dropping out on the turnaround; clavinet carries the mid-bass motion.”* — and that is a limit of the engine rather than a reading of the record. `generators::phrase_spans` re-articulates a held span only when it runs longer than two bars, so over the four-bar clip `reese_sustain` writes at most four notes and cannot reach the 500-bassline floor `engine/tests/bass.rs` holds every model to. `mobb-deep`, `dmx` and `capone-n-noreaga` carry the same substitution for the same reason; `followRootsProb` stays where it was so the line still reads as roots under the chord.
